lanes.name: This machine
lanes.note: a ComfyUI instance on this machine
lanes._downloads_comment: Optional, per lane, OFF unless you add "downloads" below -- a fresh config downloads nothing; without it, "Get it" just prints the exact `hf download ... --local-dir <ComfyUI>/models/loras/<folder>` command to run on the ComfyUI machine yourself. To turn it on: "downloads": {"loras_dir": "/absolute/path/to/ComfyUI/models/loras", "max_bytes": 4294967296}. Same machine (the common case): point loras_dir straight at ComfyUI's own models/loras folder and "Get it" downloads into the right family subfolder. Different machines: loras_dir must be a folder this app can WRITE and ComfyUI can READ -- a network share mounted on both, however you choose to share it. Either way it's an absolute path; max_bytes is optional (default 4 GiB). ComfyUI only re-lists a folder when it rescans, so a pack that just landed may need a lane refresh before it shows up as a model.
